commands.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm test
commands.ship: root=$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)") && branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) && git -C "$root" merge --no-ff "$branch" -m "Merge $branch: $FACTOR_TASK_TITLE"
